title: Finery
summary: FI'NERY, noun 1. Show; splendor; gaiety of colors or appearance; as the finery of a dress. 2. Showy articles of dress; gay clothes, jewels, trinkets, etc. 3. In iron-works, the second forge at the iro

inlines.v: FI'NERY, noun 1. Show; splendor; gaiety of colors or appearance; as the finery of a dress. 2. Showy articles of dress; gay clothes, jewels, trinkets, etc. 3. In iron-works, the second forge at the iron-mills. [See Finary.]
